name: mediastore
description: An AWS Elemental MediaStore container is a namespace that holds folders and objects.

subcommands.name: create-container
subcommands.description: Creates a storage container to hold objects.

subcommands.name: delete-container
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified container.

subcommands.name: delete-container-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the access policy that is associated with the specified container.

subcommands.name: delete-cors-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration information that is set for the container.

subcommands.name: delete-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Removes an object lifecycle policy from a container.

subcommands.name: delete-metric-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the metric policy that is associated with the specified container.

subcommands.name: describe-container
subcommands.description: Retrieves the properties of the requested container.

subcommands.name: get-container-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the access policy for the specified container.

subcommands.name: get-cors-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration information that is set for the container.

subcommands.name: get-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the object lifecycle policy that is assigned to a container.

subcommands.name: get-metric-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the metric policy for the specified container.

subcommands.name: list-containers
subcommands.description: Lists the properties of all containers in AWS Elemental MediaStore.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags assigned to the specified container.

subcommands.name: put-container-policy
subcommands.description: Creates an access policy for the specified container to restrict the users and clients that can access it.

subcommands.name: put-cors-policy
subcommands.description: Sets the cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration on a container so that the container can service cross-origin requests.

subcommands.name: put-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Writes an object lifecycle policy to a container.

subcommands.name: put-metric-policy
subcommands.description: The metric policy that you want to add to the container.

subcommands.name: start-access-logging
subcommands.description: Starts access logging on the specified container.

subcommands.name: stop-access-logging
subcommands.description: Stops access logging on the specified container.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to the specified AWS Elemental MediaStore container.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified container.
